close_reason: toolbox exposes buck2 and buck2-prelude by release date (default 2026-09-15, exact prelude match); pin names the date plus a preludeRev checked at eval
description:
## Question

Does toolbox (at the locked rev, and its registry as turnkey's teller resolves it) expose a plain `buck2` entry versioned by release date (e.g. `2026-09-15`) and a `buck2-prelude` entry versioned the same way? Which versions exist for each, what are the default versions, and is there a prelude version exactly matching every buck2 release? If not, what is the closest faithful way to name the pinned prelude exactly?

comments.text: Yes. In toolbox 064d060b as turnkey resolves it: buck2 has release-date versions 2025-12-01, 2026-03-15, 2026-04-15, 2026-07-01 and 2026-09-15, plus a 'default' version (nixpkgs buck2-unstable-2025-12-01) merged in from teller. The default is 2026-09-15. buck2-prelude has 2025-12-01, 2026-03-15, 2026-07-01 and 2026-09-15, and its default is 2026-09-15. There is NO 2026-04-15 prelude. Checked against each release's upstream prelude_hash asset: 2026-09-15 (4d101dce), 2026-07-01 and 2026-03-15 match exactly. 2025-12-01 is WRONG: toolbox has 0fabd579, upstream is 0a994e0b. buck2-toolchain 5 is buck2 2026-09-15 with reindeer 2026.09.21.00 and has no prelude. For the pin: use buck2-prelude."2026-09-15", which is exact. To make it faithful rather than trusting the date, record preludeRev = <release prelude_hash> next to rev in buck2-source.nix and assert passthru.preludeRev equals it. That makes matchingPreludeVersion unnecessary. Pin a date explicitly, never 'default'. Findings are on local bookmark research/toolbox-buck2-versions, in docs/research/toolbox-buck2-versions.md.
Findings landed on main in 827682bc (docs/research/); the research/* bookmark was deleted.

title: Which buck2 and buck2-prelude versions does toolbox expose?
